context: This criteria evaluates how effectively the engineer uses react-forgive-client package APIs to implement LSP position conversion, decoration management, color manipulation with hue preservation, and async request handling with race condition prevention.

checklist.name: Position conversion
checklist.description: Uses positionLiteralToVSCodePosition() from react-forgive-client to convert LSP Position objects (with .line and .character properties) to VS Code Position instances created via new vscode.Position()

checklist.name: Range creation
checklist.description: Uses positionsToRange() from react-forgive-client to create VS Code Range objects from pairs of LSP positions, rather than manually creating ranges

checklist.name: Decoration application
checklist.description: Uses drawInferredEffectDepDecorations() or similar pattern from react-forgive-client to apply decorations by: (1) creating decoration options with range and hoverMessage properties, (2) calling setDecorations() on the active text editor

checklist.name: Decoration clearing
checklist.description: Uses clearDecorations() from react-forgive-client to clear decorations by passing an empty array to setDecorations() on the active text editor

checklist.name: Color class usage
checklist.description: Uses the Color class from react-forgive-client with constructor(r, g, b) to create Color instances

checklist.name: Color adjustment
checklist.description: Uses the adjusted(mult) method from react-forgive-client's Color class which implements RGB redistribution algorithm to preserve hue when adjusting brightness (values > 1.0 lighten, < 1.0 darken)

checklist.name: Color formatting
checklist.description: Uses toAlphaString(a) and toString() methods from react-forgive-client's Color class to generate CSS RGBA and RGB strings respectively

checklist.name: Race condition prevention
checklist.description: Implements race condition prevention pattern from react-forgive-client using: (1) incrementing request ID counter, (2) checking if decorationRequestId === id before applying decorations, (3) discarding stale responses that don't match the latest request ID
